newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended little changed against the dollar as the Bundesbank comment that boosted the mark came after the local market closed, dealers said.
The forint ended at 182.48/53 to the dollar, compared to 182.45/50 in early trade and 182.38 at midday.
"There was little trade all day and the forint remained right on the central bank's resistance level," said Gabor Butor of Raiffeisen Unicbank.
The forint floats against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
